page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369HB processors operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, requiring reliance on external block storage options. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. For connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this instance.

Given the high memory-to-CPU ratio of 1:8 and dedicated physical cores, this instance offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for enterprise applications requiring large memory footprints without the overhead of hyperthreading. Appropriate workloads include in-memory databases, large-scale enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data processing, and memory-intensive analytics.
